USER_CONTEXT: Fix CRLF error-recovery bug in dotenv parser. Only edit src/dotenv/parser.py. Do not modify tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies. Preserve existing public behavior outside the bug. Finish once implementation is ready.

TASK_TRACKING:
- Task: Fix CRLF recovery in parse_binding error branch — Status: COMPLETED (edit applied and verified)

COMPLETED:
- Diagnosed bug: `_rest_of_line = r"[^\r\n]*(?:\r|\n|\r\n)?"` tries `\r` before `\r\n`, so on CRLF it consumes only `\r`, leaving `\n` to be swallowed as leading whitespace by the next binding. Invalid binding's original.string ends with `\r` (not full CRLF); valid binding starts with stray `\n` and wrong line number.
- Applied fix: reordered alternation to `(?:\r\n|\n|\r)?` in `_rest_of_line` in src/dotenv/parser.py.
- Verified edit is in place and consistent.

PENDING: None (implementation ready; user instructed to finish once ready).

CURRENT_STATE:
- File edited: src/dotenv/parser.py
- Change: `_rest_of_line` alternation reordered to match `_newline`/`_end_of_line` ordering (`\r\n` before `\n` before `\r`).
- No tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies modified.

CODE_STATE:
- src/dotenv/parser.py: `_rest_of_line` regex updated to `r"[^\r\n]*(?:\r\n|\n|\r)?"` (alternation reordered).
- Related existing regexes: `_newline = r"(\r\n|\n|\r)"` (line 18), `_unquoted_value = r"([^\r\n]*)"` (line 27), `_comment` (line 28).
- Error-recovery branch in `parse_binding` (approx lines 169-176) calls `reader.read_regex(_rest_of_line)`.
